flows.name: test_complete_purchase_flow
flows.findings: The flow itself works correctly end to end (cart badge shows '1', cart link navigates to /cart.html) when verified with a clean browser state. However, this test hardcodes its own selector literal ("button[data-test='add-to-cart-sauce-labs-backpack']") instead of referencing InventoryPage.ADD_TO_CART_BUTTON, which is currently broken (points to a nonexistent selector, '...-OLD-RENAMED'). The test passes today only because it bypasses the broken class constant entirely. If it is ever refactored to use inventory_page.ADD_TO_CART_BUTTON directly (the more idiomatic POM usage), it will fail. Worth reconciling the class constant and the test's literal value.
